name: browser_evidence_capture
description: Capture auditable, read-only evidence from a public web page with URL/redirect validation. Use this when a task needs browser/page observation with provenance: it returns readable page text, final URL, title, citation metadata, and a saved browser-evidence capture record. It does not click, type, log in, or mutate the page.

url.description: The http:// or https:// URL to capture.

max_length.description: Maximum readable text characters to return. Default: 6000.

mode.description: Capture mode. auto tries Readability then page text. metadata captures title/metadata only.
